svg.title: From issue() to a unit, and the queues of one flash-attention layer
svg.desc: Upper panel: a kernel on the control core calls issue(op, after(a, b)); the push checks the credit and assigns a ticket, writes the op with up to two dependencies into the 32-entry issue FIFO that crosses from the clk_rv domain to the core clock domain; the checker tsr_chk checks it; the dispatcher appends it to the in-order queue of its unit. Lower panel: the queue contents of one decode layer of flash attention with three KV chunks on the DMA, QACT, MVM and VU units: ATTQK and ATTPV on the MVM, ASMAX and AMERGE on the VU, with ATTPV and AMERGE one chunk behind.
